known_facts: The village guard (Marcus) is lazy and predictable.
The Magistrate (Kaelen) is all talk and no action.
The fastest way to get rich is to take from others, not to build.
My crew camps in the old ruins north of the village, where the walls still stand.
I served in the same company as Kaelen before the kingdom fell; he chose to build a wall, I chose to build a crew.
We take the carts on the trade road two miles east, near the split oak, where they slow at the bend.
There are nine in my crew, and three of them can actually fight.
I never rob the same caravan twice; a merchant who survives is a merchant who comes back.
Silas travels with two hired guards now, and he learned that lesson the hard way.
Winter is when we starve, so winter is when we take the most.
